svg.title: How a message reaches Receive
svg.desc: A sender calls Send with a PID and a message. The message goes into the actor's user mailbox, which holds 1024 messages by default; when it is full, the default FailSend policy makes Send return ErrMailboxFull. Each actor also has a system queue for lifecycle commands and signals such as Stop, Terminated and ChildFailed, which is never full. A turn processes the system queue first, then user messages up to a budget: 32 by default on the production engine, 1 in simulation. Receive runs once per message, one message at a time, so the actor's fields need no lock.
